title: The Tower That Couldn't Stand Up Straight

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: In 1173, Pisa started building the most beautiful bell tower in Italy.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Five years and three floors later, it was already leaning.

lines.speaker: RANIERI
lines.text: Is it supposed to do that?

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: They'd built it on soft clay. Basically, a marble tower on pudding.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: So Pisa did the logical thing, and spent almost a century fighting its neighbours instead.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Which accidentally saved it, because the soil finally had time to settle.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Later builders made the new floors taller on one side to fix the tilt.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: So now it doesn't just lean. It's a banana.
